Title: Mr. Money Mustache
Description: Long-running blog on frugal living, a high savings rate and early retirement, written in a direct, opinionated voice since 2011.
Author: Pete Adeney

Title: The White Coat Investor
Description: Personal finance and investing guidance written for doctors and other high-income professionals, covering student loans, retirement accounts and taxes.
Author: James M. Dahle

Title: A Wealth of Common Sense
Description: Ben Carlson's blog on investing, market history and the behavior of investors, with frequent charts and plain-language explanations.
Author: Ben Carlson

Title: Afford Anything
Description: Paula Pant's blog and podcast on making money decisions around priorities, covering financial independence, saving, investing and rental property.
Author: Paula Pant

Title: HumbleDollar
Description: A personal finance site edited by former Wall Street Journal columnist Jonathan Clements, with essays from many contributors on money and life.
Author: Jonathan Clements

Title: Monevator
Tags: passive investing;index funds;financial independence;uk personal finance
Description: A UK blog about passive investing, index funds and financial independence, with weekly link roundups and detailed guides for British savers.
Author: The Investor and The Accumulator

Title: Of Dollars And Data
Description: Nick Maggiulli's data-driven essays on saving, investing and wealth building, often testing common money rules against historical data.
Author: Nick Maggiulli

Title: Early Retirement Now
Tags: early retirement;safe withdrawal rates;retirement planning;financial independence
Description: In-depth quantitative research on safe withdrawal rates and early retirement planning, including a long multi-part series on the 4% rule.
Author: Karsten Jeske
